correctness.rationale: Every strictly convex quadrilateral admits the diagonal-intersection normalization 0<a<=b<=1/2. Its best vertex triangle has area (1-a)/2 and the full difference polygon has convex cyclic vertices listed in RESULT.md; omitted pairwise differences lie in the coordinate diamond. Cross products nonnegative and shoelace area 3-2a. Mixed-area polarization gives V_2=1-a=2T for all real parameters in the domain. The vertex-maximization lemma is established by separate convexity. Supplementary exact-rational checks cover 642 normalized and affine images; they do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The first nonsimplex polygon class is mathematically canonical for equality stability. An exact affine-invariant formula calibrates the Godbersen/Rogers-Shephard deficit by the intrinsic best area approximation by a triangle, determines every Q+t(-Q) area, and provides sharp triangle/parallelogram endpoints. This gives structural insight and a complete class-wise invariant not supplied by global sharp inequalities, without suggesting an extension to all convex bodies.
